title: Compatible finite-limit generators for two sheaf topoi
statement: For small sites $({\mathcal C},J)$ and $({\mathcal D},K)$ and a left-exact functor $L:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,K)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J)$, there are small finite-limit categories $\mathcal C',\mathcal D'$ and fully faithful finite-limit-preserving generator functors $G:\mathcal C'\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J)$ and $E:\mathcal D'\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,K)$, together with a finite-limit-preserving $v:\mathcal D'\to\mathcal C'$ and an isomorphism $vG\cong EL$; both generator functors contain the sheafified representables. This uses [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] and [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaf-sets-limits-sectionwise].

source.place: Tags 03CI and 03A2, finite-limit closure of a set of generators.

proof.text: For an arbitrary u-small family X in a locally u-small category with finite limits, take Mathlib ObjectProperty.limitsClosure of ofObj X for the empty diagram and WalkingCospan. LimitsClosure supplies essential smallness. The full subcategory has terminal objects and pullbacks and hence finite limits; its inclusion preserves them. Pass to equivSmallModel, transferring finite limits across the equivalence. Each X i belongs to this closure by le_limitsClosure. The sheaf categories have the needed finite limits by the cited instance.

Apply the construction first to the sheafified representables of D, then to the disjoint union of the sheafified representables of C and the images L(E d). The essential-image liftFunctor produces v with liftFunctorCompIso vG ≅ EL. The composite EL preserves finite limits, hence so does vG, and full faithfulness of G reflects them to v. The two inclusions of the disjoint union retain the representables.

theorem topos_compatibleGenerators
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    (L : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) [PreservesFiniteLimits L] :
    ∃ (C' D' : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory C') (_ : SmallCategory D')
      (_ : HasFiniteLimits C') (_ : HasFiniteLimits D')
      (G : C' ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) (E : D' ⥤ Sheaf K (Type u)) (v : D' ⥤ C'),
      G.Full ∧ G.Faithful ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits G ∧
      E.Full ∧ E.Faithful ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits E ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits v ∧
      Nonempty (v ⋙ G ≅ E ⋙ L) ∧
      (∀ U : C, ∃ c, Nonempty
        (G.obj c ≅ (presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U))) ∧
      (∀ U : D, ∃ d, Nonempty
        (E.obj d ≅ (presheafToSheaf K (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U)))
